primary_use: Multi-step research planning, source selection and cited synthesis
key_capability: Can conduct multi-step web research and return sources
critical_limit: Availability, connected sources and behaviour may vary by plan, region and product update
privacy_or_rights_note: Do not supply confidential material without authority; verify original sources
verification_required: Verify every load-bearing source and claim in the original
next_check: Before consequential use and at least monthly during an active review

primary_use: Web search and retrieval from authorised connected sources
key_capability: Can surface web sources and, where enabled, connected content
critical_limit: Source access, app permissions and capabilities are account-dependent
privacy_or_rights_note: Use least privilege and do not expose restricted content
verification_required: Verify source identity, content and permissions independently

key_capability: Can search the web and cite returned sources
critical_limit: Citation presence does not establish claim fitness or completeness
privacy_or_rights_note: Do not expose confidential project material without authority
verification_required: Open and verify the original source

primary_use: Multi-step research across web and authorised sources
key_capability: Can conduct extended research with cited sources
critical_limit: Availability and connected-source scope may vary
privacy_or_rights_note: Treat retrieved content according to its access and rights status
verification_required: Verify original sources and synthesis decisions

output_status: Candidate analysis grounded in supplied sources
key_capability: Organises and queries user-selected source sets
critical_limit: Product name and features are volatile; outputs depend on supplied source coverage
privacy_or_rights_note: Do not upload restricted full texts or confidential data without authority
verification_required: Check every quotation, citation and inference against the supplied source

primary_use: Search, screening, extraction and review workflow support
key_capability: Supports review-oriented search, screening and extraction
critical_limit: Coverage, full-text availability and extraction quality vary by record and access
privacy_or_rights_note: Respect source licences and do not treat platform access as redistribution permission
verification_required: Verify publication-to-study identity, eligibility and extracted data

key_capability: Returns answers linked to source labels
critical_limit: Source labels do not certify claim-level accuracy, coverage or authority
privacy_or_rights_note: Do not supply confidential project content without authority
verification_required: Open and verify the original source and source fit

key_capability: Can identify and merge probable duplicate library records
critical_limit: Duplicate detection does not resolve publication-to-study identity automatically
privacy_or_rights_note: Review attached files, rights and retained metadata before merging
verification_required: Confirm DOI, title, authors, version and study identity

primary_use: Insert and update citations and bibliographies
critical_limit: Tracked changes, manual edits and field conversion can disrupt links
privacy_or_rights_note: Retain a controlled library and do not expose private notes in public exports
verification_required: Verify citation identity, placement and final bibliography after field updates
next_check: Before Editorial Gate and after major edits

primary_use: Retrieve DOI metadata and related record information
key_capability: Can retrieve registered metadata for DOI records
critical_limit: Registered metadata may be incomplete, stale or not equivalent to the full source
privacy_or_rights_note: Metadata retrieval does not grant content rights
verification_required: Compare against the publisher or official record for load-bearing sources
next_check: At corpus freeze and final source audit

primary_use: Check current-status information for participating records
key_capability: Can expose updates, corrections and retractions for participating content
critical_limit: Absence of Crossmark information does not prove an object is current
verification_required: Check publisher record and other retraction/update sources where consequential
next_check: Before final claim and source audit

primary_use: Traverse main text, headers, footers, footnotes, endnotes and other stories
key_capability: Supports complete field-update workflows across story types
critical_limit: Ctrl+A then F9 in the main story does not update every story range
privacy_or_rights_note: Run on a controlled copy and retain the authoritative source
verification_required: Verify field results, headers, footers and lists after update

key_capability: Supports fixed-format PDF export with structure tags and bookmark options
critical_limit: A successful export does not prove correct fonts, pagination, navigation or accessibility
privacy_or_rights_note: Use only the controlled source and retain output hash
verification_required: Inspect PDF metadata, fonts, links and every page

primary_use: Detect supported secret patterns and block some pushes
key_capability: Can block supported secrets before admission to a repository
critical_limit: Coverage is pattern- and entitlement-dependent; absence of an alert is not proof of safety
privacy_or_rights_note: Minimise data, revoke exposed secrets and review history
verification_required: Perform independent secret, privacy and rights audit

primary_use: Package tagged repository states and release assets
key_capability: Can associate assets and notes with a tagged state
critical_limit: A release does not resolve rights, privacy, licence or scientific validity
privacy_or_rights_note: Do not publish the manuscript or restricted assets without a rights decision
verification_required: Verify tag, commit, assets, manifest, rights and privacy

primary_use: Create records, reserve DOIs and link versions
key_capability: Can reserve a DOI and create versioned records
critical_limit: A reserved DOI is not a published record; post-publication file changes are constrained
privacy_or_rights_note: Confirm rights, licence, privacy and publisher terms before deposit
verification_required: Verify metadata, files, version relationship and publication status

primary_use: Declare a licence for deposited files
critical_limit: Selecting a licence cannot create rights the depositor does not hold
privacy_or_rights_note: The v1.2.0 file-class licence decision is recorded in the release register
verification_required: Obtain an explicit author/publisher/institutional rights decision
